saints.name: St. Rose of Lima
saints.title: Virgin
saints.shortBlurb: The first canonized saint of the Americas, a Dominican tertiary of Lima given to penance and prayer…
biography: Isabel Flores de Oliva was born at Lima in Peru in 1586 and called Rose from childhood for her beauty. Refusing marriage, she became a member of the Third Order of St. Dominic, living at home in a garden hut and supporting her family by needlework while giving herself to severe penance and long hours of prayer.

She cared for the sick, the poor, and the enslaved of the city, and passed through deep mystical trials and consolations. She died in 1617 at the age of thirty-one and in 1671 became the first person born in the Americas to be canonized, patroness of Peru and of all Latin America.
saints.knownFor: Being the first canonized saint of the Americas.
